title: Template:Weapon-info
wikitext:
Template intended for use in [[:Category:Weapons|weapon]] articles. All fields are optional and are hidden if empty. == Usage == === Example === 
{{Weapon-info
 | ammo = Cells
 | ammousage = 1/shot
 | shottype = Hitscan
 | dmgpershot = 30
 | dmgpersec = 300
 | range = 600
 | reloadtime = 0.1s
}}
The code above will appear as follows. {{Weapon-info | ammo = Cells | ammousage = 1/shot | shottype = Hitscan | dmgpershot = 30 | dmgpersec = 300 | range = 600 | reloadtime = 0.1s }}
    {{ #if: {{{ammo|}}} |
  • '''Ammo:''' {{{ammo|}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{ammousage|}}} |
  • '''Ammo usage:''' {{{ammousage|}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{shottype|}}} |
  • '''Shot type:''' {{{shottype|}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{dmgpershot|}}} |
  • '''Damage per shot:''' {{{dmgpershot|}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{dmgpersec|}}} |
  • '''Damage per sec (max):''' {{{dmgpersec|}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{range|}}} |
  • '''Range:''' {{{range|}}} units |}} {{ #if: {{{reloadtime|}}} |
  • '''Reload time:''' {{{reloadtime|}}} |}}
